raw_text: Use PHP 8.4+ syntax only; Add `declare(strict_types=1);` to every PHP file; Make all classes final unless inheritance is required; Use readonly properties wherever possible; Use constructor property promotion; Use typed properties and return types; Follow PSR-12 coding standards; Never use `var_dump()` or `dd()` in production code; Run these commands before committing: `composer test`, `composer lint`, `composer test:unit`, `composer test:types`, `composer refactor`; Member-only requests must use `RequiresMemberAuth` trait; use VincentAuger\DataCiteSdk\Traits\Requests\RequiresMemberAuth; Requests extend `Saloon\Http\Request`; Requests are `final`; DataCite.php is the main client entry point.
